Do not promote any human_category value until a reviewer has confirmed it. Leave 'human_category' as null for unreviewed entries.

proposals.question: How do model-registry and odh-model-controller interact for model deployment?
proposals.expected_answer: model-registry does not define CRDs; it watches KServe InferenceService CRDs from other components. odh-model-controller defines a NIM Account CRD and watches KServe InferenceService, ServingRuntime, InferenceGraph, and LLMInferenceService CRDs. The interaction is that model-registry tracks model artifacts and versions, while odh-model-controller manages the deployment lifecycle of model serving resources. For LLMInferenceService specifically, odh-model-controller extends KServe with Kuadrant security via a two-controller architecture (GatewayReconciler and LLMInferenceServiceReconciler).
